headline_marked: Harry Kane [[reaches 100 Bundesliga goals]] in record 98 games as Bayern thrash Union Berlin 7-0
headline: Harry Kane reaches 100 Bundesliga goals in record 98 games as Bayern thrash Union Berlin 7-0
summary: England captain Harry Kane shattered the Bundesliga goalscoring record, hitting his century in just 98 matches. Bayern Munich secured a dominant 7-0 victory.
details: Harry Kane became the fastest player to score 100 Bundesliga goals on Friday, achieving the milestone in just 98 domestic games. He scored twice in Bayern Munich's resounding 7-0 demolition of Union Berlin, surpassing the previous record held by Dieter Mueller since 1977.

The England captain's brace means he has now scored 156 goals in 156 games for Bayern across all competitions, an unparalleled statistic. This latest record adds to his collection of fastest goalscoring milestones for the club.
Bayern Munich, wearing a special Oktoberfest kit, took an early lead through Jamal Musiala in the 18th minute. Kane then doubled their advantage from the penalty spot for his 100th goal.
Michael Olise was also a standout performer, scoring a hat-trick. He added to Bayern's tally before halftime and continued his impressive display in the second half, netting two more goals.

Further goals from Davies and Saibari sealed the comprehensive victory for Bayern. The win temporarily puts the champions at the top of the Bundesliga table, though other teams can reclaim the summit.

Union Berlin, who are still searching for their first win of the season, conceded seven goals and are struggling in the league. Their performance highlighted a stark contrast to Bayern's dominant display.

Michael Olise was also a standout performer, scoring a hat-trick. He added to Bayern's tally before halftime and continued his impressive display in the second half, netting two more goals.

headline_marked: Brentford [[hammer Chelsea 3-0]] to climb to 3rd in Premier League
headline: Brentford hammer Chelsea 3-0 to climb to 3rd in Premier League
summary: The Bees exposed Chelsea's defensive frailties, leaving Xabi Alonso with plenty to ponder during the international break.
details: Brentford secured a dominant 3-0 victory over Chelsea on Friday, moving up to third place in the Premier League table.
Goals from Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago, and Fabio Carvalho sealed the win, continuing Brentford's strong start to the season.
Chelsea, managed by Xabi Alonso, have struggled recently, picking up only one point from their last three league matches.
The Blues' attack was subdued without the injured Joao Pedro, while their defense continued to struggle, conceding at least twice in every league game under Alonso.
Jaidon Anthony opened the scoring after the hour mark, followed by Igor Thiago's first Premier League goal of the season on a rebound.
Fabio Carvalho added a third in stoppage time, capping off a comprehensive defeat for the visitors.
Brentford now sit behind only defending champions Arsenal and Manchester City at the top of the table.
caption:
Brentford climb to 3rd place after a crushing 3-0 win over Chelsea!

Brentford secured a dominant 3-0 victory over Chelsea on Friday, moving up to third place in the Premier League table.

Goals from Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago, and Fabio Carvalho sealed the win, continuing Brentford's strong start to the season.

Chelsea, managed by Xabi Alonso, have struggled recently, picking up only one point from their last three league matches.

The Blues' attack was subdued without the injured Joao Pedro, while their defense continued to struggle, conceding at least twice in every league game under Alonso.

Jaidon Anthony opened the scoring after the hour mark, followed by Igor Thiago's first Premier League goal of the season on a rebound.

Fabio Carvalho added a third in stoppage time, capping off a comprehensive defeat for the visitors.

Brentford now sit behind only defending champions Arsenal and Manchester City at the top of the table.
